276683772.description: This lot includes a variety of vintage and collectible writing instruments and accessories. Also featured is a Coca-Cola themed ballpoint pen with a colorful case. The collection contains a Speedball Flicker Pen nib set, a feather quill dip pen set with ink and nibs, and a vintage K&E Leroy lettering set with multiple technical pens. Most items are in their original presentation or storage boxes. Conditions range from gently used to unused. Materials include metal, plastic, wood, and specialty finishes. Colors and styles vary throughout the collection.

Collection of assorted raw mineral and gemstone specimens including amethyst (purple), fluorite (purple and green), aventurine (green), citrine (yellow), sodalite (blue), red jasper, carnelian (orange), and clear quartz or calcite (clear/white).
